noteContents.title: GROUP BY + HAVING: the most-asked pattern
Subqueries: compare with an average or a person

DBMS · Solved Past QuestionsSQL III: multi-table joins Q10 Project(Project_id, Project_name, Manager_name), Location(location_id, Location_name, project_id), Employee(Employee_id, Employee_Name, Location_id, Joining_date, Salary): show project_name, Location_name and total salary of each project's employees who joined before January 2021.APSCL AE(ICT) 2021 SELECT p.Project_name, l.Location_name, SUM(e.Salary) AS Total_salary FROM Project p JOIN Location l ON l.project_id = p.Project_id JOIN Employee e ON e.Location_id = l.location_id WHERE e.Joining_date < '2021-01-01' GROUP BY p.Project_name, l.Location_name; → Payroll | Dhaka | 50000 · e-Banking | Ctg | 60000 · e-Banking | Dhaka | 45000 Q11 employee(id, name, salary), equipment(id, name, price), hire(employee_id, equipment_id): name of the employee who borrowed the most equipment.BAPEX AGM(ICT) 2023 SELECT e.name, COUNT(*) AS items FROM employee e JOIN hire h ON h.employee_id = e.id GROUP BY e.id, e.name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hire GROUP BY employee_id) t); → Chand | 3 (ties are all shown: safer than ORDER BY … LIMIT 1) Q12 Product(pname, price, category, maker), Purchase(buyer, seller, stock), Company(cname, country), Person(per-name, address, phone); maker = cname, buyer/seller = per-name. (a) Persons who bought a product made by an American company. (b) Sum of all products and of all sold products by country.NWPGCL AM(ICT) 2024 (a) SELECT DISTINCT pu.buyer FROM Purchase pu JOIN Product p ON p.pname = pu.stock JOIN Company c ON c.cname = p.maker WHERE c.country = 'USA'; (b) SELECT c.country, (SELECT SUM(p2.price) FROM Product p2 JOIN Company c2 ON c2.cname = p2.maker WHERE c2.country = c.country) AS all_products, SUM(p.price) AS sold_value FROM Purchase pu JOIN Product p ON p.pname = pu.stock JOIN Company c ON c.cname = p.maker GROUP BY c.country; → sample: Apple iPhone 1000 + Dell XPS 1500 (USA), Walton Primo 200 (Bangladesh), Primo sold twice: (a) Rafi, Shoeb · (b) Bangladesh | 200 | 400 · USA | 2500 | 2500 Assumption to write "American category" is read as made by a company whose country is USA; Purchase.stock is read as the product name. State such readings in one line: examiners reward it. 5
